children: By Eman Hamed
Egyptian developer Modon Developments is targeting the start of handovers across key projects in East and West Cairo in 2027 as it advances an approximately 11-project portfolio, its CEO said.
CEO Ahmed Osama told Zawya Projects that the company’s developments span East and West Cairo, the New Administrative Capital (NAC) and the North Coast.

In the NAC, Modon aims to complete the 30-storey Green River Tower within eight months. The project has total investments of 3.5 billion Egyptian pounds ($69 million), of which EGP1.1 billion ($22 million) has been invested to date.
Osama said around 15 percent of the tower has been sold, with the company planning to offer the remaining units following completion.
Structural works have also been completed on The Tower, Modon Mega Tower and Modon Hotel & Residence in the NAC, while other developments are targeted for completion within six months, he said.
New Cairo
In New Cairo, construction progress has exceeded 65 percent across Boutique Village, Boutique Business Village and Boutique Village 2.
Modon has invested EGP1.5 billion ($29 million) of a planned EGP3 billion ($59 million) in Boutique Village, Osama said.
The 17,500-square-metre (sqm) first phase has been fully sold, with handovers scheduled to start in June 2027.

The mixed-use commercial, administrative and residential development is being implemented in two phases. Concrete works for the first phase are targeted for completion by the end of 2026, while the entire project is scheduled for delivery within 18 months.
West Cairo
In Sixth of October City, Modon plans to start first-phase handovers at its EGP10 billion ($196 million) Villagio development in early 2027, initially delivering around 120 units.
The 42-acre project comprises 230 units, including standalone villas, townhouses and twin houses, alongside serviced apartments, healthcare facilities, lagoons and green spaces.
Osama said construction of the villas, sports academy and commercial areas has exceeded 80 percent.

An 11,000 sqm commercial and sports academy zone, which includes a Totti Soccer School led by former Italian footballer Francesco Totti, is scheduled to open in October 2026 alongside selected retail outlets. Modon launched Villagio in September 2024.

The developer has also partnered with Bin Baz Developments on Villagio Gray, a 22-acre mixed-use development in New October City. The project will predominantly comprise residential villas, which account for 80 percent of the development, alongside apartments, commercial space and a 90-room hotel managed by Campbell Gray Hospitality.
Construction is expected to start before the end of 2026, with delivery targeted within three years.

Modon’s wider portfolio includes the 43-acre Golf Town in New Cairo’s Sixth Settlement, the 60-acre New Capital Lagoons in the R8 district and Lagoons Al Alamein on the North Coast, being developed in cooperation with the New Urban Communities Authority.
(1 US Dollar = 50.98 Egyptian Pounds)
